svg.title: LEVI's layers: one entry layer, one capability boundary, domain modules, adapters
svg.desc: Agent work from the web UI, REST, MCP and CLI goes through one capability layer that enforces permissions, revisions and undo; domain modules sit below it; stores, FFmpeg and model workers at the bottom, with heavy models in isolated environments.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four interfaces, one capability layer for agent work, ten main modules, and the adapters beneath them.

svg.text: Permissions (read · draft · execute · approve · commit) · revision checks · idempotency keys · undo · audit trail

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Used by the Agent Workbench, the agent REST routes, MCP and `levi agent`: a scoped agent connection cannot reach a person-only action by another route.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Direct routes (convert, pool, annotate, live, automatic) have their own checks: plan before run, same-origin writes, person-only routes refuse agent credentials.

svg.text: Rules that hold in every layer

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Source data is read-only: conversion and export write to new folders. · The core never imports Torch: heavy models run in their own environments.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Unknown is never success: an unavailable judge is reported as unavailable. · Every long-running child process is registered and reclaimed on stop or restart.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A model's suggestion becomes a label only through a person's commit; the live service's audited auto-approver is the one exception, and marks its labels `auto`.
